correctness.rationale: The weighted induction over two depth-n categorical stochastic trees is valid for arbitrary nonnegative starting masses: the overlap is a jointly concave sum of minima in the first-symbol laws, minimized at extreme categorical laws. Coincident peaks yield F_n(s,t)>=F_{n+1}(s,t) by marginalization and differing peaks yield the extremal two-law product F_{n+1}. The oldest-symbol construction attains the lower bound for states (1,...,1) and (2,...,2), proving minimax sharpness. The multinomial formula, Hellinger square-root tilt and lazy symmetric span-one local CLT with dominated summation give the exact constant coth(t/2)/sqrt(4*pi*u). Neutral symbols imply strict decline for q>=3. The deviation-matrix identity plus oscillation contraction yields the normalized hitting bound, sufficient (not necessary) for uniform hitting times when a<theta. Independently verified exact rational overlap and attained minimax q=3,4 and d=1,2,3; this finite computation is not a universal proof.
